headlines.title: UBS agrees to takeover of stricken Credit Suisse for $3.25bn
UBS Agrees to Buy Rival Credit Suisse
headlines.abstract: In a deal brokered by the Swiss government, Switzerland’s largest bank will buy its smaller rival for about $3.2 billion.

headlines.title: Hedge Funds That Bet on Credit Suisse Rescue Face Uneven Results
headlines.abstract: Among the funds to bet on the rescue deal were two that specialize in buying the bonds of companies on the brink of bankruptcy.

headlines.title: UK and US shares climb as banks and ministers aim to calm Credit Suisse fears
Thousands of UK jobs at risk after UBS takeover of Credit Suisse
